```{r}
# Plan de parallélisation (multisession pour Windows)
nbCores <- 7
plan(multisession, workers = nbCores)

cp_metrics <- function(algo = "MonAlgo", cp_true, cp_est, tol = 5)
{
  # Force plain integer vectors (handles list-columns safely)
  cp_true <- as.integer(unlist(cp_true))
  cp_est  <- as.integer(unlist(cp_est))
  
  # Edge cases
  if (length(cp_true) == 0 && length(cp_est) == 0)
  {
    data.frame(
      Algo = algo,
      Precision = NA_real_,
      Recall = NA_real_,
      F1 = NA_real_
    )
  }
  
  if (length(cp_true) == 0) # only false alarms
  {
    precision <- 0
    recall    <- NA_real_
    
    data.frame(
      Algo = algo,
      Precision = precision,
      Recall = recall,
      F1 = NA_real_
    )
  }
  if (length(cp_est) == 0) # all misses
  {
    precision <- NA_real_
    recall    <- 0
    data.frame(
      Algo = algo,
      Precision = precision,
      Recall = recall,
      F1 = NA_real_
    )
  }
  
  # Pairwise absolute distances
  D <- abs(outer(cp_true, cp_est, "-"))
  
  # Greedy matching: just pick the closest unmatched estimate within tolerance
  matched_est <- rep(FALSE, length(cp_est))
  TP <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(cp_true))
  {
    j <- which.min(D[i, ])
    if (length(j) && D[i, j] <= tol && !matched_est[j])
    {
      TP <- TP + 1
      matched_est[j] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  FP <- sum(!matched_est)
  FN <- length(cp_true) - TP

  precision <- if ((TP + FP) > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA_real_
  recall    <- if ((TP + FN) > 0) TP / (TP + FN) else NA_real_
  f1 <- if (!is.na(precision) && !is.na(recall) && (precision + recall) > 0)
    2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) else NA_real_
  
  data.frame(
      Algo = algo,
      Precision = precision,
      Recall = recall,
      F1 = f1
    )
}

####################################
###### Fonction de simulation ######
####################################
simu_OP <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  penalty <- 30
  gap <- 2
  # Changepoints relatifs
  chpts <- c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1) * n
  
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(
    chpts      = chpts,
    parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
    sdNoise    = 1.5
  )
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  time_R <- system.time(optimal_partitioning(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  time_Rcpp <- system.time(optimal_partitioning_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), OP_R = time_R, OP_Rcpp = time_Rcpp)
}

simu_PELT <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  gap <- 1
  chpts = floor(seq(1, n, length.out = floor(5*n/1000)))
  parameters = rep(c(0,gap), floor(5*n/2000))
  m <- min(length(chpts), length(parameters))
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = chpts[2:m],
                         parameters = parameters[2:m],
                         sdNoise = 0.2,
                         type = "gauss")
  penalty <- 2 * log(length(data))
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  time_R <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  time_Rcpp <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), OP_R = time_R, OP_Rcpp = time_Rcpp)
}

simu_SVP_PELT_with_change <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  gap <- 1
  chpts = floor(seq(0, n, length.out = floor(6*n/1000)+1))[-1]
  parameters = rep(c(0,gap), ceiling(6*n/2000))
  data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = chpts,
                         parameters = parameters[1:length(chpts)],
                         sdNoise = 0.2,
                         type = "gauss")
  penalty <- 0.1 * log(length(data))
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  time_SVP <- system.time(SVP(data, penalty, "gaussian_mean"))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  time_PELT <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), SVP_Rcpp = time_SVP, PELT = time_PELT)
}

simu_SVP_PELT_nochange <- function(n)
{
  # Constantes locales
  penalty <- 1
  
  # data
  data <- rnorm(n, 0, 0.1)
  
  # Chrono avec pruning
  time_SVP <- system.time(SVP(data, penalty, "gaussian_mean"))[["elapsed"]]
  
  # Chrono sans pruning (Rcpp)
  time_PELT <- system.time(pelt_rcpp(data, penalty))[["elapsed"]]
  
  list(n = length(data), SVP = time_SVP, PELT_Rcpp = time_PELT)
}

n <- 20000
data <- c(rnorm(n/4, 0, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 2, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 4, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 6, 1))
chpts <- seq(n/4, n, length.out=4)
  
penalty_pelt <- 2 * log(length(data)) * dust::sdDiff(data, "HALL")^2
penalty_svp <- 1.5 * log(length(data))

PELT_Rcpp <- pelt_rcpp(data, penalty_pelt)
SVP_Rcpp <- SVP(data, penalty_svp, "gaussian_mean")

simu_F1_Score_PELT <- function(n)
{
  data <- c(rnorm(n/4, 0, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 3, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 0, 1),
          rnorm(n/4, 3, 1))
  chpts <- c(n/4,n/2,3*n/4,n)
  
  penalty_pelt <- 2 * log(length(data)) * dust::sdDiff(data, "HALL")^2
  penalty_svp <- log(length(data))
  
  PELT_Rcpp <- pelt_rcpp(data, penalty_pelt)
  SVP_Rcpp <- SVP(data, penalty_svp, "gaussian_mean")
  
  PELT_F1 <- cp_metrics(algo = "PELT", chpts, PELT_Rcpp$changepoints, tol = n/1000)$F1
  SVP_F1  <- cp_metrics(algo = "SVP", chpts, SVP_Rcpp$changepoints, tol = n/1000)$F1
  
  list(n = length(data), PELT = PELT_F1, SVP = SVP_F1)
}

####################################
###### exécution en parallèle ######
####################################

# vecteur de tailles à tester
start <- 1000
end   <- 10000
# my_n_vector <- round(10^(seq(log10(start), log10(end), length.out = 20)))
my_n_vector <- round(seq(start, end, length.out = 5))

# nombre de répétitions par n
p <- 20

# lancer toutes les simulations
results <- future_lapply(my_n_vector, function(n) {
  print(paste("Running n =", n))
  replicate(p, simu_SVP_PELT_nochange(n), simplify = FALSE)
}, future.seed = TRUE)

# aplatir la liste
results_flat <- do.call(c, results)

##########################################
###### mise en data.frame final ##########
##########################################
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results_flat, as.data.frame))

head(df)

write.csv(df, "C:/Users/alexa/Desktop/2024-2025/LaMME/changepoints/simulations/timeSIGNAL.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r ggplot_simulation}
#####################################
###### lire et transformer df #######
#####################################
MyData <- read.csv("C:/Users/alexa/Desktop/2024-2025/LaMME/changepoints/simulations/SVP_PELT.csv")

# Mise au format long (PELT vs PELT_Rcpp)
df <- MyData %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(names(MyData)[2], names(MyData)[3]),
               names_to = "method",
               values_to = "time")

# Nettoyage : retirer NA, Inf, temps nuls ou négatifs
df <- df %>% filter(is.finite(time), time > 0)

############################################
###### résumé avec moyenne et quantiles ####
############################################
data_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(n, method) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
            q1 = quantile(time, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            q3 = quantile(time, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# Limites pour l'axe Y (sécurisé)
theMin <- min(data_summary$q1[data_summary$q1 > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
theMax <- max(data_summary$q3[data_summary$q3 > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

##########################################
###### régressions log-log (scalabilité) #
##########################################
lm_results <- df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  do(model = lm(log(time) ~ log(n), data = .))
lm_results$method
lm_results$model

coef(lm_results$model[[1]])[2] # PELT
coef(lm_results$model[[2]])[2] # SVP
time <- data_summary$mean[seq(1,39,by=2)] # PELT
n <- data_summary$n[seq(1,39,by=2)]
lm(log(time) ~ log(n))

################################
###### PLOT with ggplot2 #######
################################
svg("C:/Users/alexa/Desktop/2024-2025/LaMME/changepoints/simulations/SVP_PELT.svg", width = 12, height = 8)
par(bg = "white")
ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = n, y = mean, col = method)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, level = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10(limits = c(theMin, theMax)) +
  labs(y = "Time in seconds",
       x = "Length of data",
       color = "Méthode",   # titre de la légende
       shape = "Méthode") +
  geom_point(size = 2, aes(shape = method)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), width = .01) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("PELT" = "blue", "SVP_Rcpp" = "red"),
                      labels = c("PELT" = paste("PELT slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[1]])[2], 4)),
                                 "SVP_Rcpp" = paste("SVP slope :",  round(coef(lm_results$model[[2]])[2], 4)))) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("PELT" = 16, "SVP_Rcpp" = 16),
                     labels = c("PELT" = paste("PELT slope :",  round(coef(lm_results$model[[1]])[2], 4)),
                                "SVP_Rcpp"     = paste("SVP slope :", round(coef(lm_results$model[[2]])[2], 4)))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = c(0,1),
        legend.justification = c(0,1),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("darkred", 0.2), colour = "NA"),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = alpha("black", 0.3)))
dev.off()

# Résumés des modèles
summaries <- lapply(lm_results$model, summary)

# Coefficients (intercept + pente log-log)
coeffs <- lapply(lm_results$model, coef)

print("=== Coefficients (intercept, slope) ===")
print(coeffs)
```

```{r ggplot_F1_Score}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Charger les données
df <- read.csv("~/changepoints/simulations/timeSIGNAL.csv")

# Transformer en format long (utile si plusieurs méthodes dans le CSV)
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -n,
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "F1"
  )

# Calculer moyenne et écart-type par méthode et par n
df_summary <- df_long %>%
  group_by(n, method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_F1 = mean(F1),
    sd_F1   = sd(F1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Graphique type "points + lignes + barres d’erreur"
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = n, y = mean_F1, color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_F1 - sd_F1, ymax = mean_F1 + sd_F1),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Number of samples", y = expression("F1-score (Mean " %+-% "Std)")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(start, end), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Algorithmes",
                     values = c("PELT" = "blue", "SVP" = "green"),
                     labels = c("PELT", "SVP")
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position = c(0.8,0.2),
        legend.justification = c(0,1),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("darkred", 0.2), colour = "NA"),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = alpha("black", 0.3)))
#theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
```
